text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, you're really fired up today, 
Ines-san!\nIs it because it's your 
birthday?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is coming up soon! My family 
used to take me to watch it as a present♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even though I said they didn't have to, 
they insisted 'because it's your 
birthday!' and bought me sooo many local 
specialty donuts and skewers.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eating yummy food, having fun with 
everyone. It was the best birthday ever♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... I'm so moveeeed!!!! Getting the 
greatest race ever as a present, what an 
incredible birthday this isss!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then Ines's present has to be something as 
amazing as the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uwahhh...! That truly might be a case of 
"nothing compares to a sweet carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A gift like the Derby, where everyone's 
hard work clashes and fires up even those 
watching...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Aha. Then, could I make a request to the 
two of you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for us to go to the Derby 
together♪ I just know the three of us will 
have a blast!
